why: Naive start: one crawler process keeps a BFS queue in memory, fetches, parses and writes pages to a database. It works for a few thousand pages, but ~770 pages/s at ~1 s per fetch needs about a thousand fetches in flight (N2), the in-memory queue is lost on crash (N3), BFS order hammers whichever site it is in the middle of (N1), and a SQL DB can't hold 1.2 PB.
